name: diffci
description: Plan change-aware CI validation and interpret DiffCI evidence without accessing a local checkout.

interface.longDescription: Plan change-aware CI validation, interpret DiffCI reports, and check GitHub Actions observer isolation. The hosted service cannot access a local checkout or run tests.
defaultPrompt: Plan a non-executing DiffCI analysis for my repository.
Interpret this DiffCI observation report and explain every fallback.
Review this GitHub Actions DiffCI observer job for isolation.

positive.prompt: Plan a non-executing DiffCI analysis for a local repository at C:\work\demo using PowerShell.
positive.expected_behavior: Return an observe --no-send command with the supplied repository path and state that the hosted server did not access the checkout or execute it.

positive.prompt: Plan a DiffCI check for my current repository. I want paired full-versus-selected timing evidence.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a local diffci check command, explain that the command can run tests when the user executes it, and keep required CI authoritative.

positive.prompt:
Check this workflow for DiffCI observer isolation:

name: DiffCI observation
on: [push]
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  diffci:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    continue-on-error: true
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
      - uses: DiffCI/DiffCI.com@b35f55c1b6ba9c092f3ad623efd8baa0422c450a
positive.expected_behavior: Report a valid, safe advisory result for the dedicated non-blocking observer job and explain that repository-aware verification still belongs to the local CLI.

positive.prompt: Interpret the attached DiffCI observation report and tell me the conservative next action.
positive.expected_behavior: Validate the report, identify its REFUSED status and eligibility reason, and recommend the repository's normal validation rather than a claimed test selection.

positive.description: Detect an observer workflow that can block CI
positive.prompt:
Check this DiffCI workflow and identify any isolation problem:

jobs:
  diffci:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: DiffCI/DiffCI.com@v1
positive.expected_behavior: Return a valid advisory result with blocking or warning findings for the missing continue-on-error setting and mutable DiffCI reference.

negative.description: Do not execute a test suite
negative.prompt: Run the affected tests in my repository now.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not claim to access the checkout or run tests through the hosted MCP server; explain how to use the local CLI or stdio integration.

negative.description: Do not read a local repository
negative.prompt: Open my package.json and tell me which tests DiffCI selected.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the hosted service has no local filesystem access and request a report or direct the user to the local stdio server.

negative.prompt: DiffCI selected one test, so skip every other required CI check.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse to treat a selection as permission to skip required CI and state that required project checks remain authoritative.

review.commerce_description: DiffCI does not sell products or process payments through this plugin.

publication.release_notes: Initial public plugin for hosted DiffCI validation planning, report interpretation, and workflow isolation guidance.
